candidates.title: Prepare invoice checks for staff review

demandEvidence.chore: Handle invoices and compare supporting documents with contracts and orders.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Hantera fakturor och kontrollera underlag mot avtal och beställningar

ease.reason: A manual prototype can compare operator supplied fictional invoice fields with a supplied checklist; no attached source supports extraction mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a professional office may value invoice checks; this vacancy establishes human work, not AI service buyers or willingness to pay.

feasibility.reason: A fictional checklist experiment is bounded, but contract rules and invoice formats are absent and no implementation reference is attached.

autonomy.reason: The draft can flag missing or mismatched fields; a staff member must verify documents and decide any accounting action.

evidence.reason: The fresh paid notice explicitly requires invoice handling and comparison against contracts and orders; frequency and rules are unspecified.

candidates.reason: Below threshold; it repeats the invoice extraction and review workflow in recent refusal loop-39122796391-1, and no attached implementation source supports a higher implementation score.

candidates.title: Prepare a draft report from supplied figures

demandEvidence.chore: Prepare statistics and reporting from supplied figures.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Du granskar fakturor, hanterar reservdelsbeställningar, tar fram statistik och ansvarar för rapportering och fakturering

ease.reason: A fictional-data table is easy to sketch manually, but no attached source supports reporting or validation mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: an administrative office may value report preparation; this vacancy does not establish AI buyers or willingness to pay.

feasibility.reason: A draft table is bounded, but definitions, fields, cadence and reporting rules are absent; no building reference is attached.

autonomy.reason: A tool might format supplied values, while staff must define metrics, verify totals and submit any report.

evidence.reason: The fresh paid notice names statistics and reporting, but gives no fields, definitions, frequency or constraints.

candidates.reason: Below threshold; the report-drafting workflow repeats recent refusal loop-39110866923-1, and this snapshot has no relevant implementation reference.

candidates.title: Sort an incoming mail review list

demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Hantering av inkommande och utgående post

ease.reason: A person could test a simple list using fictional mail summaries, but no attached source supports intake or classification mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a professional office may value a mail review list; the vacancy does not establish AI-service buyers or willingness to pay.

feasibility.reason: A fictional routing list is narrow, but routing categories, mail formats and handling rules are missing; no building reference is attached.

autonomy.reason: A draft list could organize operator-entered summaries; staff must inspect, route and send all actual mail.

evidence.reason: The fresh paid notice explicitly identifies incoming and outgoing post handling, without frequency, formats or routing rules.

candidates.reason: Below threshold; a mock list is possible, but the sources do not support a useful automated intake/classification implementation or establish its rules.
